plugins.description: Opt-in, macOS: a resident WeCom (企业微信) AI bot whose replies are written by headless, tool-less Claude Code. Requests that need you become numbered to-dos pushed to your WeCom; what the owner says to the bot goes into a Claude Code terminal on the Mac (tmux, with tools), with each reply pushed back to WeCom. Ships wecom-cli setup steps and a launchd agent that keeps the long connection alive.
